verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents its own install paths: a free Docker self-host option and a desktop download that gets an agent running 'in minutes'. Community users confirm a single-install desktop package and a working setup in under 5 minutes. However, the pack never shows the actual one-line documented command (Docker run/compose or installer script), and one Linux user hit an install error that needed a manual chrome-sandbox permission fix. Missing for 10: the exact documented one-command install (e.g., the docker run line) shown in first-party docs, and evidence of a clean Linux install without manual permission workarounds.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I can install the assistant on my own machine with one documented command — installer script, npm/pip package, or Docker image — and reach a working chat in minutes

citations.quote: Download AnythingLLM and get a privacy-focused, extensible, and capable AI agent running on your device in minutes.
had it running in under 5 minutes
